operations.description: Convert a file to another format with any of ConvertAPI's converters, such as Word to PDF or PDF to JPG. Extra file inputs (like a template or overlay file) are not supported here; use Custom API Call for those.

inputs.description: The format of the file you are converting.
inputs.label: From Format
inputs.name: from

inputs.description: What to convert the file into.
inputs.label: To Format
inputs.name: to

inputs.description: Files to add after the main one, for converters that combine files.
inputs.label: Additional Files
inputs.name: additionalFiles

inputs.description: Options of the chosen converter. Leave empty for the defaults.
inputs.label: Conversion Options
inputs.name: options

operations.name: Convert File

operations.description: Combine several PDF files into one PDF, in the order you list them.

inputs.description: Add the PDFs in the order they should appear. At least two are needed.
inputs.label: PDF Files
inputs.name: files

inputs.description: Merged file name, without the extension. Leave empty for a default.
inputs.label: Output File Name
inputs.name: fileName

inputs.description: Only needed if the PDFs are password-protected. Used for every file.
inputs.label: Password
inputs.name: password

inputs.description: Add a top-level bookmark for each merged file.
inputs.label: Bookmark Each File
inputs.name: bookmarksTableOfContents

inputs.description: Scale every page to this size, or keep the original size.
inputs.label: Page Size
inputs.name: pageSize

inputs.description: Rotate every page to this orientation, or keep the original.
inputs.label: Page Orientation
inputs.name: pageOrientation

operations.name: Merge PDF Files

operations.description: Split a PDF into several PDFs by page count, page ranges, single pages, matching text or bookmarks.

inputs.description: How the PDF is cut into parts.
inputs.label: Split By
inputs.name: mode

inputs.description: What to split on. The format depends on the Split By mode.
inputs.label: Split Value
inputs.name: value

inputs.description: Join the parts back into one PDF, e.g. to extract selected pages.
inputs.label: Merge Parts Into One PDF
inputs.name: mergeOutput

inputs.description: Only needed if the PDF is password-protected.
inputs.label: Password
inputs.name: password

inputs.description: Base name for the parts, without extension. Each part gets a number.
inputs.label: Output File Name
inputs.name: fileName

operations.name: Split PDF File
